correction.what_was_wrong: 1.0.14 priced IndexTTS-2 per request, on the reasoning that the workflow exposes no duration PARAMETER. That conflated 'the caller cannot choose a length' with 'there is no billable length'. AutoDL's own definition for this workflow carries price_type 'audio_sec_cost', so it is billed per second of delivered audio.
correction.how_the_mistake_happened: the capability table was read for input_rules only; the price_type and billing_config fields on the same official record were never inspected, even though the motion workflow had already established the measured-seconds pattern this is an exact analogue of.
correction.unit_error_also_corrected: billing_config stores raw units where raw x 0.001 = CNY (confirmed by the shipping wan price: raw video_sec_cost.price 40 -> the live expression uses 0.04). The raw values were first read as yuan, which overstated the TTS price by 1000x (1 yuan/s and a 10 yuan minimum instead of 0.001 yuan/s and a 0.010 yuan minimum).
correction.source_of_truth: the operator's own pricing page for the workflow, plus official-workflows.json billing_config

official_billing.measurement: AutoDL bills the actual generated-audio duration; the workflow has no duration parameter, so the delivered file is the only source

implementation.rationale_for_the_name: every workflow reports its billable length as `seconds`, including the H3 audio-sync workflow whose parameter is audio_duration, so one pricing expression idiom covers all models
implementation.reservation_rationale: equal to the vendor minimum charge, so a short clip is never under-held and a post-charge difference cannot appear
parsers_added: mp3Duration (ID3v2 skip, frame sync, Xing/Info frame count)
settlement_priority: fresh measurement of the delivered file
implementation.never_billed: the upstream data.duration field, which is render wall time (observed 196 and 206) and is not audio length

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: every WAV looked unmeasurable, so settlement always fell back to the reservation and the real clip length was never billed
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: the WAV parser reused the big-endian u32 built for MP4/EBML, but RIFF stores chunk sizes and fmt fields little-endian; each chunk size read as hundreds of millions and walked the cursor off the buffer
bugs_found_and_fixed.fixed: dedicated u16le/u32le readers plus an authoritative fmt byteRate with a derived fallback

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: polling any task whose model name had no capability table failed with 'unsupported model; select one of the 17 declared models'
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: parseTaskResult called workflow(), which THROWS on an unknown name, instead of testing membership; this broke the unmapped-private-name path that 1.0.13 exists to support
bugs_found_and_fixed.fixed: membership test with a fallback to the media type saved at submission

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: polling failed for a public alias whenever the channel did not map it back to the workflow id
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: parseTaskResult looked the name up without resolving aliases, contradicting the standalone alias resolution used on submission
bugs_found_and_fixed.fixed: aliases are resolved on the polling path too

regression_protection.method: revert each part of the change and confirm the suite fails
reverts: bill TTS per request again (give it no seconds input)
read WAV fields big-endian again (the parsing bug)
trust the header byteRate without a bounds-checked data chunk
stop measuring the delivered audio at settlement
drop the saved-type fallback for unmapped names
give TTS the motion 5-second reservation instead of the vendor minimum
omit the TTS reservation when replaying an OpenAI-style body

live_pricing.billing_expr: hour("Asia/Shanghai") < 8 ? (u("seconds") < 10 ? tier("off_peak_minimum", 0.01) : tier("off_peak", u("seconds") * 0.001)) : (u("seconds") < 10 ? tier("peak_minimum", 0.01) : tier("peak", u("seconds") * 0.001))
live_pricing.note: peak and off-peak rates are both CNY 0.001/s today; the split is written out so a future divergence is a one-number edit
live_pricing.host_caching: the host serves billing options from memory, so a database write alone leaves the price invisible; the option API reload is required
